reason: The pet is cute and I'd probably keep a streak going on the free demo, but I'm not paying a monthly subscription on top of my investments when my robo-adviser already does the rebalancing for me. A waitlist for a paid plan with no price yet isn't something I'd sign up for on my commute.
objection: A monthly fee eats into returns on a portfolio my size, and I'd be handing real money to an AI agent from an app that's only run on demo money so far, with a broker partner that isn't even named yet.
would_change_my_mind: If it cost the same as or less than what my robo-adviser takes now, with no separate subscription, and the broker partner was a name I already trust.
